sub: Peshawar and D.I. Khan tests delayed by
paragraphs: FPSC ne Khyber Pakhtunkhwa mein **Phase-III/2026** General Recruitment Tests **multawi** kar diye hain.
Yeh tests **12 se 19 October** tak **Peshawar** aur **D.I. Khan** ke centres mein hone thay.
FPSC ke mutabiq soobe ki mojooda soorat-e-haal aur candidates ki darkhwast par yeh faisla kiya gaya.
Baqi soobon mein tests purane schedule par hi honge. **Nayi tareekhein** baad mein FPSC website par aayengi.
question: Kya aap ka bhi FPSC test tha? Comment mein batayein
